critical_code_review_comments: Fix rationale: on a 1920px viewport the Emergent badge occupies x=1726..1904 (178px wide + small inset). Any padding-right < 194px on a form whose right edge is 1920 leaves the flex end-item inside the badge's hit area. md:pr-48=192px is still short. md:pr-52 (208) is the minimum safe value; pr-56 (224) gives cushion for badge width fluctuation.

Send button <button> has 'h-11 w-11' but no 'shrink-0'. In a flex row with input flex-1 and a constrained parent width (chat panel ≈ 459px), the button is allowed to shrink to min-content (icon 16px). Always set shrink-0 on icon-only buttons in flex rows.

Raising the row above the badge via md:pb-16 is more robust than relying purely on horizontal padding because the badge width can vary across environments; y-clearance avoids the class of issues entirely.

rca of the issue: Root cause: at 1920x1080, the Emergent platform badge (<a id=emergent-badge>) is fixed at bottom-right spanning x=1726..1904, y=1024..1064 (178x40 plus padding). The ChatPanel form's right edge aligns with the viewport right edge (1920). The form uses padding-right: 192px (md:pr-48). The send button is the last flex item in the form. Because the button has h-11 w-11 but no shrink-0, flex shrinks it to icon width (16px). Measured button rect: x=1756..1772, y=1017..1061. Both x and y ranges fall inside the badge's bounding box, so Playwright's click at button center hits the badge first (higher z-order) and reports 'subtree intercepts pointer events'. Mitigation: (a) md:pr-56 (224px) to push the button left of x=1726, OR (b) md:pb-16 to push button up above y=1024, plus shrink-0 so the button renders at its intended 44px width and has a full clickable area. Reproduction: goto /ai, viewport 1920x1080, fill chat-input, page.click('[data-testid=chat-send-btn]') → timeout with emergent-badge intercept log.
